```{r read-datasets}

# cleaned copy of "ScarryExport10-5-16.xlsx"
signs_all <- read.delim("data_files/scarry_homesigners_all.txt")

# sign IDs that need substituting
id_substitutions <- read.csv("data_files/id_substitutions.csv")

eng_descrips_actions <- read.delim("data_files/eng_descrips_actions.txt", encoding = "UTF-8")
eng_descrips_objects <- read.delim("data_files/eng_descrips_objects.txt", encoding = "UTF-8")

# copy of "Spanish descriptions.xlsx" sheet "coding"
span_descrips_all <- read.csv("data_files/span_descrips_all.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

# prev called "mand_coded.txt"
mand_descrips_all <- read.csv("data_files/mand_descrips_all_edit.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

# copy of "SCAR.TF.E.01-42.xlsx" sheet "data_include" - seed fails are excluded
eng_judgment <- read.delim("data_files/eng_judgments_include.txt")

# copy of "Scarry_Span_tool_focus_seeds_March 22, 2019_04.02.xlsx" sheet "Scarry_Span_tool_focus_seeds" - no one failed
span_judgment <- read.csv("data_files/span_tool_focus_seeds.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

# copy of "Mandarin tool focus w seeds_March 8, 2021_11.11" w no-data rows deleted
mand_judgment <- read.csv("data_files/mand_tool_focus_seeds.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")

# seed verbs
eng_seed_verb_list <- scan("data_files/eng_seed_verbs.txt", what = "list")
span_seed_verb_list <- scan("data_files/span_seed_verbs.txt", what = "list")
mand_seed_verb_list <- scan("data_files/mand_seed_verbs.txt", what = "list")

# area ratio & handshape ratings for each pic ID
area_ratio <- read.delim("data_files/area_calculations.txt")
area_ratio$ID <- as.factor(area_ratio$ID)

handshape_rating <- read.delim("data_files/handshape_rating_data.txt") 
handshape_rating$ID <- as.factor(handshape_rating$ID)

# ids & colors for figures
ids_colors <- read.delim("data_files/ids_figure_color.txt")
ids_colors$ID <- as.factor(ids_colors$ID)

object_ids <- read.delim("data_files/object_ID_glosses.txt")

ids_glosses <- read.delim("data_files/ids_glosses.txt")
ids_glosses$ID <- as.factor(ids_glosses$ID)
ids_glosses$gloss <- as.factor(ids_glosses$gloss)

```

```{r clean-hs-data}

# remove blank columns, trimws, and convert to factors

colnames(id_substitutions)[1] <- "original"

signs_all <- signs_all[,-7:-8]

signs_all$handshape <- trimws(signs_all$handshape, "both")
signs_all$scarry_id <- trimws(signs_all$scarry_id, "both")
signs_all$referent <- trimws(signs_all$referent, "both")

# clean responses
## match entire cell
id_substitutions$orig_regex <- paste("^",id_substitutions$original,"$", sep = "")
## do substitution
signs_all$ID <- mgsub(signs_all$scarry_id,id_substitutions$orig_regex,id_substitutions$substitution)

signs_all <- signs_all %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

# we either don't have norms for these or they are machines
## some of these are 'non-instrumental objects' - tool use is depicted in the gesture but not in the book image 
ids_exclude <- c("226","256","91","234","235","236","237","244","204","210","207","221","230","233","253")

signs_all_main <- filter(signs_all, !(ID %in% ids_exclude))
```


```{r clean-spoken-data}

eng_descrips_all <- rbind(eng_descrips_actions, eng_descrips_objects[-6])

# trim whitespace
eng_descrips_all$verb <- trimws(eng_descrips_all$verb, "both")

## change 'verb_pinyin' to 'verb'
colnames(mand_descrips_all)[6] <- "verb"

## clean punctuation
mand_descrips_all$verb <- gsub("-", ".", mand_descrips_all$verb)

eng_descrips_all <- eng_descrips_all %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

span_descrips_all <- span_descrips_all %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

mand_descrips_all <- mand_descrips_all %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

# assign binary value to 'instrument' column

eng_descrips_all$has_instrument <- if_else(eng_descrips_all$instrument == "",0,1)

span_descrips_all$has_instrument <- if_else(span_descrips_all$instrument == "",0,1)

# convert qualtrics files to long format

## english
eng_judgment_long <- eng_judgment[,-2:-4] %>% pivot_longer(.,cols= !subj,names_to="verb",values_to = "response")

eng_judgment_long$verb <- gsub("break.","break", eng_judgment_long$verb)

eng_judgment_long <- eng_judgment_long %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

eng_judgment_main <- filter(eng_judgment_long, !(verb %in% eng_seed_verb_list)) %>% droplevels()

## spanish
span_judgment_clean <- span_judgment[-1:-2,] %>% .[,-1:-17]
span_judgment_clean_long <- span_judgment_clean[,-2:-4] %>% pivot_longer(.,cols= !subject,names_to="verb",values_to = "response")

span_judgment_clean_long <- span_judgment_clean_long %>% mutate_if(is.character,as.factor)

span_judgment_main <- filter(span_judgment_clean_long, !(verb %in% span_seed_verb_list)) %>% droplevels()

### change response value
span_judgment_main$score <- ifelse(span_judgment_main$response == 1,1,0)

## chinese
mand_judgment_clean <- mand_judgment[-1:-2,] %>% .[,-1:-19]

## remove speakers where MAND == 'no'
mand_judgment_clean <- filter(mand_judgment_clean, !(MAND == "否" | MAND == "No"))

mand_judgment_clean_long <- mand_judgment_clean[,-2:-3] %>% select(.,-mTurkCode) %>% pivot_longer(.,cols= !ID, names_to="verb",values_to = "response")

mand_judgment_clean_long$response_code <- ifelse(mand_judgment_clean_long$response == "是",1,0)

```

```{r mand-seed-trials}

mand_seed_strong <- c("kun3","cheng1.zhong4", "chou1.da3",	"dan3", "feng2", "nian3",	"pai1.she4",	"ti4",	"zha1")
mand_seed_weak <- c("fan1",	"sa3",	"tuo1",	"chui1",	"xian1",	"xiu1.gai3",	"zhen3.duan4",	"an4",	"pai2.lie4")

mand_judgment_seeds <- filter(mand_judgment_clean_long, grepl("seed", mand_judgment_clean_long$verb) | grepl("instr_", mand_judgment_clean_long$verb))

mand_judgment_seeds$score <- ifelse((grepl("kun3|cheng1.zhong4|chou1.da3|dan3|feng2|nian3|pai1.she4|ti4|zha1", mand_judgment_seeds$verb) & mand_judgment_seeds$response_code == 1) | (grepl("fan1|sa3|tuo1|chui1|xian1|xiu1.gai3|zhen3.duan4|an4|pai2.lie4", mand_judgment_seeds$verb) & mand_judgment_seeds$response_code == 0),1,0)

# make wide
mand_judgment_seeds_subj <- filter(mand_judgment_seeds, grepl("seed", mand_judgment_seeds$verb)) %>% pivot_wider(., id_cols= ID, names_from = "verb", values_from = "score")

# sum seed trials by subj
mand_judgment_seeds_subj <- mutate(mand_judgment_seeds_subj, score_mean = rowMeans(select_if(mand_judgment_seeds_subj, is.numeric)))

# remove 'seed_xian1' - had 41% accuracy
mand_judgment_seeds_subj <- select(mand_judgment_seeds_subj, !seed_xian1) %>% mutate(., score_mean = rowMeans(select_if(., is.numeric)))

# ppl who passed seed trials
mand_subj_succeed <- filter(mand_judgment_seeds_subj, score_mean > .7) %>% pull(.,ID)

# filter out seed fails
mand_judgment_main <- filter(mand_judgment_clean_long, !(verb %in% mand_seed_verb_list) & ID %in% mand_subj_succeed) %>% droplevels()
```


```{r spoken-data-description}

# of scenes
filter(eng_descrips_all, type == "action") %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(N=length(ID)) %>% nrow()
filter(eng_descrips_all, type == "object") %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(N=length(ID)) %>% nrow()

# frequency of verbs in descrip task
eng_verbs_counts <- summary(eng_descrips_all$verb, maxsum = 1000) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(eng_verbs_counts)[1] <- "count"

span_verbs_counts <- summary(span_descrips_all$verb, maxsum = 1000) %>% as.data.frame() 
colnames(span_verbs_counts)[1] <- "count"

mand_verbs_counts <- summary(mand_descrips_all$verb_character, maxsum = 1000) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(mand_verbs_counts)[1] <- "count"

# % of total descrip tokens that were tested in judgment studies
## 'push' wasn't tested bc we didn't have descrips for 229 yet
filter(eng_verbs_counts, count > 3) %>% summarise(sum=sum(count))/ nrow(eng_descrips_all)

filter(span_verbs_counts, count > 3) %>% summarise(sum=sum(count))/ nrow(span_descrips_all)

filter(mand_verbs_counts, count > 2) %>% summarise(sum=sum(count))/ nrow(mand_descrips_all)

# of verbs (includes value '0')
summary(span_judgment_main$verb, maxsum = 150) %>% as.data.frame(.) %>% nrow(.)

```

```{r judgments-by-verb}

## create judgment summaries by verb
eng_judgment_by_verb <- eng_judgment_main %>% group_by(verb) %>% summarise(mean_judgment = mean(response), N_judgment = length(response))

span_judgment_by_verb <- span_judgment_main %>% group_by(verb) %>% summarise(mean_judgment = mean(score), N_judgment = length(score))

mand_judgment_by_verb <- mand_judgment_main %>% group_by(verb) %>% summarise(mean_judgment = mean(response_code), N_judgment = length(response_code))
```

```{r join-descrips-judgments}

eng_descrips_all <- left_join(eng_descrips_all, eng_judgment_by_verb)

span_descrips_all <- left_join(span_descrips_all, span_judgment_by_verb)

mand_descrips_all <- left_join(mand_descrips_all, mand_judgment_by_verb)

# summarise by ID

images_summary <- eng_descrips_all %>% group_by(type, ID) %>% summarise(eng_judgment_mean = mean(mean_judgment, na.rm = T)) 

images_summary <- span_descrips_all %>% group_by(type, ID) %>% summarise(span_judgment_mean = mean(mean_judgment, na.rm = T)) %>%  left_join(images_summary, .)

images_summary <- mand_descrips_all %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(mand_judgment_mean = mean(mean_judgment, na.rm = T)) %>%  left_join(images_summary, .)

images_summary <- images_summary %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(all_judgment_mean = rowMeans(select(.,eng_judgment_mean,span_judgment_mean, mand_judgment_mean), na.rm = T))

# join area ratio & handshape ratings

images_summary <- left_join(images_summary, select(area_ratio, ID, instr_agent_ratio))

handshape_rating_by_id <- handshape_rating %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(rating_mean = mean(response), rating_sd = sd(response))

images_summary <- left_join(images_summary, select(handshape_rating_by_id, ID, rating_mean))

images_summary <- left_join(images_summary, ids_colors)

```

```{r homesign-summary-stats}

signs_all_main$code <- if_else(signs_all_main$handshape == "handling", 0, if_else(signs_all_main$handshape == "object", 1, NULL))

# join w images_summary (no 'type' column)
signs_all_main <- left_join(signs_all_main, images_summary[,-1])

non_homesigners <- c("NCHS022","NASL(cs)394")

hs_paper <- c("GCHS01", "GCHS02","GCHS03","GCHS05","GCHS07","GCHS09","NCHS003","RCHS010","UCHS003", "TCHS109")

# by ID
hs_action_by_id <- signs_all_main %>% filter(., subject %in% hs_paper) %>% filter(., referent == "action") %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(mean_object_hs = mean(code,  na.rm = T), N = length(code))

hs_object_by_id <- signs_all_main %>% filter(., subject %in% hs_paper) %>% filter(., referent == "object") %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarise(mean_object_hs = mean(code,  na.rm = T), N = length(code))

hs_action_by_id <- left_join(hs_action_by_id, images_summary[,-1])
hs_object_by_id <- left_join(hs_object_by_id, images_summary[,-1])

# by handshape
signs_all_main %>% filter(., subject %in% hs_paper) %>% filter(., referent == "action") %>% group_by(handshape) %>% summarise(N = length(handshape))

signs_all_main %>% filter(., subject %in% hs_paper) %>% filter(., referent == "object") %>% group_by(handshape) %>% summarise(N = length(handshape))
```

```{r homesign-by-subj}

hs_action_by_subj <- signs_all_main %>% filter(., subject %in% hs_paper) %>% filter(., referent == "action") %>% droplevels(.) %>% group_by(subject, cut(all_judgment_mean, breaks = 2) ,.drop = F) %>% summarise(mean_object_hs = mean(code,  na.rm = T), N = length(code))

  xlim(0,1)


## instrumental handshape vs. handshape rating
ggplot(filter(hs_action_by_id, N > 0),aes(x=rating_mean, y=mean_object_hs, size=N, color=figure_color)) + 
  geom_point(stat = "identity") + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=figure_color), min.segment.length = 0, size = 5, box.padding = .5) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide="none") + 
  labs(y = "homesigner instrumental handshape rate", x = "shape match rating") + 
  theme_clean(base_size = 14) + xlim(1,5)


## instrumental handshape vs. area ratio
p <- ggplot(filter(hs_action_by_id, N > 0),aes(x=instr_agent_ratio, y=mean_object_hs, size=N)) + geom_point(stat = "identity")

p <- p + labs(y = "proportion of signs with instrumental handshape", x = "instrument/agent ratio") + theme_bw(base_size = 14) + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))


## Individual subject plots
### actions
ggplot(hs_action_by_subj, aes(x=all_mean_bin, y = mean_object_hs, fill=all_mean_bin)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(alpha=N), stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = N, vjust = -.3), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() + scale_alpha_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~subject_clean, ncol=6) + theme_few() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) + 
  ylim(0,1) + 
  labs(y = "proportion of signs with instrumental handshape\n", x = "\nspoken language tool prominence (events)")
            
### objects
ggplot(hs_object_by_subj, aes(x=all_mean_bin, y = mean_object_hs, fill=all_mean_bin)) +
  geom_bar(aes(alpha=N), stat = "identity", colour = "black") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = N, vjust = -.3), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = .25, end=.75) +
  scale_alpha_continuous() + 
  facet_wrap(~subject_clean, ncol=6) + theme_few() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) + 
  ylim(0,1) + 
  labs(y = "proportion of signs with instrumental handshape\n", x = "\nspoken language tool prominence (objects)")

```
